A €100 non-refundable deposit secures your date and is deducted from the wedding-day total. Your date is reserved only once the deposit has been paid: without the deposit, no date is held and it remains open to other bookings. Travel beyond 10 km of Barcelona is €1.50 per km. April to November, locations over 100 km require a minimum of five services. Cancellations under 42 hours are charged in full. All email communication is considered a contract.

How it works

01

The consultation

Your date, venue, party size and dress in one short form. We agree a look direction, timeline and team size before anything is booked.

By email or video · included
02

Deposit

€100 secures your date. Non-refundable, deducted from the wedding-day total.

03

The trial

Up to three hours at the atelier or your location. We build and test the full look, photograph it in daylight and flash, and adjust until it is unmistakably you.

From 11:00 · €440 · deducted from Full & Exclusive packages
04

The wedding morning

We arrive with an agreed schedule, set up two stations and work the party in 45-minute slots, finishing on you. Optional Beauty Corner for touch-ups between ceremony and portraits.
